entry.name: accentColor
entry.label: The accent colour of the tiles menu. Windows derives it from the system accent; here it is a free choice (pressed group title, group drag placeholder and the sidebar marker).

entry.name: compactMode
entry.label: Use the non-fullscreen Start menu (the Windows 10 windowed layout: sidebar, application list and a tile area whose width and height can be dragged).

entry.name: compactColumns
entry.label: Columns of groups in the windowed Start menu (1..4). Dragging the panel's right edge changes it.

entry.name: compactHeight
entry.label: Height of the windowed Start menu panel, in design pixels. Dragging the panel's top edge changes it.

entry.name: tileSkin
entry.label: Tile skin: "modern" (translucent tiles, the later Windows look) or "early" (coloured tiles of Windows RTM, see plans/EARLY-STYLE-INTEGRATION.md).

entry.name: tilePalette
entry.label: Colour palette of the early skin (default, vivid, pastel, dark, transparent, red, pink, purple, indigo, blue, teal, green, lime, yellow, orange, brown, grey).

entry.name: liveTilesEnabled
entry.label: Show live content (clock, battery, date) on tiles the user marked as live tiles (right-click a tile, "动态磁贴").

entry.name: weatherSource
entry.label: Plasma weather source for weather tiles, e.g. "bbcukmet|weather|Beijing". Leave empty to keep the tiles empty.

entry.name: pulseOnUpdate
entry.label: Pulse the tile when its live content changes (Square Home's "pulse" animation: 1 -> 1.1 in 300 ms, then 1 -> 0.91).

entry.name: liveTileVariant
entry.label: Which content-swap animations the live tiles use: "auto" (slides and flips mixed), "slide" (only the 4 slide variants) or "flip" (only the 4 centre flips). Useful to compare the two.

entry.name: liveTileCycle
entry.label: Cycle a live tile between its icon and its live content, like the Windows live tiles do (every 4-6 seconds).

entry.name: moreLiveAni
entry.label: Use all 12 content-swap animations (the 4 slide variants only otherwise).

entry.name: themedIcon
entry.label: Icon style of the early skin: "auto" (white silhouette, symbolic when the theme has one), "letter" (first letter of the app name), or "color" (keep the application's coloured icon).

entry.name: forceAppColor
entry.label: Use the application's own colour as the tile background when it is saturated and bright enough (Windows uses the app's declared colour, Square Home validates it in HSV).
